description: Manages the metadata and structural configuration of entities and their fields within the system, including their properties, display settings, and relationships.

endpoints.name: GetEntities
endpoints.description: Retrieve a list of all available entities in the system, primarily for populating dropdowns or selection lists.
example_uses: List all entities configured in the system.
Show me the available entities.
What entities can I select from?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need a comprehensive list of all configured entities for display or selection purposes, such as populating a dropdown menu.

endpoints.name: GetEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Retrieve the detailed configuration for a specific entity, including its description and field configurations, used for frontend screen generation.

entityName.description: The name of the entity to retrieve configuration for.

example_uses: Get the configuration for the 'Partner' entity.
Show me how the 'Contact' entity is set up.
What are the fields defined for 'Project'?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to fetch the complete schema and display settings for a particular entity to render its associated UI or understand its structure.

endpoints.name: SaveEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Update the description and field configurations for an existing entity. This allows modifying an entity's metadata and its associated fields.

entityName.description: The name of the entity to save configuration for.

request.description: The request body containing the entity's description and field configurations.

Fields.description: A list of field configurations for the entity. Each field configuration includes properties like FieldName, DataType, IsRequired, IsActive, EnableChangeLog, DisplayOrder, ShowInListView, etc.

example_uses: Update the description of the 'User' entity.
Modify the fields for the 'Product' entity.
Save new field settings for the 'Order' entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to update the overall description of an entity or make changes to the configuration of its existing fields, such as their data types, required status, or display properties.

endpoints.name: GetAllEntityConfigurations
endpoints.description: Retrieve all entity configurations stored in the system, typically for administrative overview or bulk management.
example_uses: List all entity configurations.
Show me the setup for all entities.
Get a complete overview of the system's data models.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to view or manage the configurations of all entities in the system, often for administrative purposes.

endpoints.name: CreateEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Create a new entity configuration in the system, defining its name, associated database table, and initial properties.

request.description: The request body containing the details for the new entity configuration.

EntityName.description: The unique name of the new entity.

TableName.description: The name of the database table associated with this entity.

Description.description: A description for the new entity.

IsActive.description: Indicates if the entity configuration is active.

EnableChangeLog.description: Indicates if change logging is enabled for this entity.

example_uses: Create a new entity called 'Invoice' linked to the 'Invoices' table.
Define a new 'Asset' entity with change logging enabled.
Set up a new 'Department' entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to introduce a completely new entity type into the system and define its fundamental properties and database mapping.

endpoints.name: UpdateEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Update an existing entity configuration identified by its ID, allowing modification of its name, table, description, and active status.

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity configuration to update.

request.description: The request body containing the updated details for the entity configuration.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the entity configuration.

EntityName.description: The updated unique name of the entity.

TableName.description: The updated name of the database table associated with this entity.

Description.description: An updated description for the entity.

IsActive.description: The updated active status of the entity configuration.

EnableChangeLog.description: The updated change logging status for this entity.

example_uses: Update the 'Project' entity configuration with ID 123.
Change the table name for the entity with ID 456.
Modify the active status of entity 789.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to modify the core properties of an existing entity configuration, such as its name, associated table, or whether it's active.

endpoints.name: DeleteEntityConfiguration
endpoints.description: Delete an entity configuration from the system using its unique identifier.

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity configuration to delete.

example_uses: Delete the 'TemporaryData' entity configuration with ID 10.
Remove entity configuration 5 from the system.
Can you delete the entity configuration for 'OldReport'?
endpoints.when_to_use: When an entity configuration is no longer needed and should be permanently removed from the system.

endpoints.name: GetEntityFields
endpoints.description: Retrieve all field configurations associated with a specific entity configuration, identified by its manager ID.

entityManagerId.description: The unique identifier of the entity configuration whose fields are to be retrieved.

example_uses: Get all fields for the entity configuration with ID 1.
Show me the field definitions for entity manager 5.
List the fields configured for the 'User' entity configuration.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to inspect or display the detailed field definitions for a particular entity configuration.

endpoints.name: CreateEntityField
endpoints.description: Create a new field configuration for an existing entity, defining its name, data type, and display properties.

request.description: The request body containing the details for the new entity field.

EntityManagerId.description: The ID of the entity configuration this field belongs to.

FieldName.description: The unique name of the new field.

DataType.description: The data type of the field (e.g., 'string', 'integer', 'boolean', 'DateTime').

IsRequired.description: Indicates if the field is mandatory.

IsActive.description: Indicates if the field is active.

EnableChangeLog.description: Indicates if change logging is enabled for this field.

DefaultValue.description: The default value for the field.

MaxLength.description: The maximum length for string fields.

DisplayOrder.description: The order in which the field should be displayed.

ShowInListView.description: Indicates if the field should be shown in list views.

ListViewOrder.description: The display order in list views.

RelatedDisplayProperty.description: The property to display from a related entity.

DisplayFieldPath.description: The path to the display field for nested objects.

DisplayTemplate.description: The template for displaying the field.

ListViewLabel.description: The label for the field in list views.

ListViewType.description: The type of display in list views.

ListViewWidth.description: The width of the column in list views.

ListViewEllipsis.description: Indicates if text should be ellipsized in list views.

ListViewSortable.description: Indicates if the column is sortable in list views.

FirstLetterFallbackField.description: Fallback field for first letter display.

example_uses: Add a 'StartDate' field of type 'DateTime' to the 'Project' entity.
Create a new required text field named 'Notes' for the 'Task' entity.
Define a boolean field 'IsApproved' for the 'Document' entity.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to add a new field to an existing entity's configuration, specifying its properties and behavior.

endpoints.name: UpdateEntityField
endpoints.description: Update an existing field configuration for an entity, identified by its unique field ID.

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity field to update.

request.description: The request body containing the updated details for the entity field.

Id.description: The unique identifier of the entity field.

EntityManagerId.description: The ID of the entity configuration this field belongs to.

FieldName.description: The updated unique name of the field.

DataType.description: The updated data type of the field.

Description.description: An updated description for the field.

IsRequired.description: The updated mandatory status of the field.

IsActive.description: The updated active status of the field.

EnableChangeLog.description: The updated change logging status for this field.

DefaultValue.description: The updated default value for the field.

MaxLength.description: The updated maximum length for string fields.

DisplayOrder.description: The updated order in which the field should be displayed.

ShowInListView.description: The updated status of whether the field should be shown in list views.

ListViewOrder.description: The updated display order in list views.

RelatedDisplayProperty.description: The updated property to display from a related entity.

DisplayFieldPath.description: The updated path to the display field for nested objects.

DisplayTemplate.description: The updated template for displaying the field.

ListViewLabel.description: The updated label for the field in list views.

ListViewType.description: The updated type of display in list views.

ListViewWidth.description: The updated width of the column in list views.

ListViewEllipsis.description: The updated status of whether text should be ellipsized in list views.

ListViewSortable.description: The updated status of whether the column is sortable in list views.

FirstLetterFallbackField.description: The updated fallback field for first letter display.

HelperText.description: The updated helper text for the field.

example_uses: Update the data type of the 'Amount' field with ID 10.
Change the display order for field 25.
Mark field 30 as not required.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to modify the properties of an existing field within an entity's configuration.

endpoints.name: DeleteEntityField
endpoints.description: Delete a specific field configuration from an entity using its unique field ID.

id.description: The unique identifier of the entity field to delete.

example_uses: Delete the 'OldField' with ID 42.
Remove field configuration 15 from the system.
Can you delete the field 'TemporaryColumn'?
endpoints.when_to_use: When a specific field is no longer needed within an entity's configuration and should be permanently removed.

endpoints.name: GetRelatedEntityFields
endpoints.description: Retrieve available fields for a specified related entity type, useful for configuring relationship fields between entities.

entityType.description: The type of the related entity to retrieve fields for.

example_uses: Get fields for the 'User' entity type to define a relationship.
List available fields for 'Organization' when setting up a lookup.
What fields can I link to from 'Contact'?
endpoints.when_to_use: When you are defining a relationship field (e.g., a foreign key or lookup) and need to see which fields are available on the target entity for display or linking.

endpoints.name: GetFieldOptionsForDataType
endpoints.description: Retrieve specific field options or configurations relevant to a given data type within the context of a particular entity.

dataType.description: The data type for which to retrieve field options (e.g., 'string', 'integer').

contextEntityName.description: The name of the entity providing context for the field options.

example_uses: Get field options for 'string' data type in the 'Product' entity context.
What are the options for 'integer' fields in the 'Order' entity?
Retrieve configurations for 'boolean' fields related to 'Task'.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to understand specific configuration options or constraints for a field based on its data type and the entity it belongs to.

endpoints.name: GetEntityListViewConfiguration
endpoints.description: Retrieve the list view configuration for a specific entity, which dictates how its data should be displayed in a list or table format (e.g., columns, order, visibility).

entityName.description: The name of the entity to retrieve list view configuration for.

example_uses: Get the list view settings for the 'User' entity.
How should the 'Project' entity be displayed in a list?
Retrieve column configurations for the 'Contact' list.
endpoints.when_to_use: When you need to dynamically generate a list or table view for an entity, requiring information about which fields to display, their order, and other presentation details.
